definitions.ask: How should the gog binary be installed?

choices.label: A chezmoi installer pinned to v0.44.0 with an embedded sha256; upgrades are deliberate commits
Chezmoi installer tracks the newest GitHub release weekly, like lazygit; machines auto-upgrade
A one-off install on apollo only; no chezmoi change, so the next fresh machine repeats this breakage

definitions.why: gog holds Gmail credentials and sase_gmail relies on its safety flags; upgrades deserve review

definitions.ask: How should apollo get its Gmail authorization?

choices.label: Copy athena's encrypted gog state over SSH; no browser, but both machines share one refresh token
Copy only the OAuth client; Bryan approves a new read-only consent and pastes back one redirect URL

definitions.why: athena's read-only token is healthy and copying it needs no interactive OAuth round trip

definitions.ask: Should the installer also replace athena's May source build now?

choices.label: Run the installer on athena now and verify it with auth doctor; both machines run one release
The installer skips source builds (git-describe versions), so athena stays on v0.16.0-18

definitions.why: one verified release beats silent drift, and v0.44.0 reads athena's existing state unchanged
